summary: Completed comprehensive SEO Foundation testing for Dynicty Landing Page. Fixed critical meta tag duplication issue in index.html. All 17 SEO requirements validated successfully with 100% pass rate.

fixed_bugs.issue: Duplicate Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags causing SEO validation failures
fixed_bugs.fix: Removed static OG and Twitter tags from index.html (lines 37-49). All SEO tags now exclusively managed by react-helmet-async via SEO.jsx component
fixed_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - Fixed duplicate meta tags on all 5 pages (og:type, og:site_name, og:locale, og:image, og:image:width, og:image:height, twitter:card, twitter:image)

passed_tests: ✅ All 5 pages have unique, correct titles (Home, Contact, Privacy, Terms, 404)
✅ All pages have exactly 1 meta description (no duplicates, unique per page)
✅ All pages have exactly 1 canonical link with correct URLs
✅ All Open Graph tags present and unique per page (og:type, og:site_name, og:locale, og:url, og:title, og:description, og:image, og:image:width=1200, og:image:height=630)
✅ All Twitter Card tags present and unique per page (twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image)
✅ Meta robots correct: index,follow for marketing pages (Home/Contact/Privacy/Terms), noindex,nofollow for 404
✅ No duplicate meta tags on any page (description, og:*, twitter:*, canonical)
✅ JSON-LD schemas correct: 6 schemas on Home (Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage), 4 schemas on other pages (Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList)
✅ Breadcrumb schema items correct: Home=1 item, Contact/Privacy/Terms=2 items each
✅ robots.txt valid with User-agent:*, Allow:/, Disallow rules for /admin, /dashboard, /platform, /api, /auth, /login, /oauth, and Sitemap: https://dynicty.com/sitemap.xml
✅ sitemap.xml valid XML with 4 URLs (dynicty.com/, /kontak, /privacy, /terms), no forbidden URLs
✅ manifest.json accessible with name='Dynicty', theme_color='#05060F', display='standalone', icons array with 192/512/180 sizes
✅ manifest.json link present in HTML (<link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'>)
✅ Landing page functionality normal: hero renders, navbar present, no JS console errors
✅ No 'Sinar Telur' branding in SEO metadata (title, meta description, og:title, og:description, JSON-LD schemas)
✅ All pages have lang='id' or 'id-ID' in html tag
